items.title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
items.snippet: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. items.snippet: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback.
